name: Product Sale Timer for WooCommerce
author: Satish Prajapati

sections.description:
Product Sale Timer for WooCommerce is a lightweight and easy plugin that displays a countdown timer on website, individual WooCommerce product pages. Whether a sale is coming soon or currently running, the timer helps create urgency and improves conversions.

Main Features:
– 🕒 Very easy to use — no coding needed
– ⏳ Show countdown timers using a simple shortcode
– 🔔 Customised Pre-sale message: “Sale starts in…” countdown
– 🔥 Customised Live sale message: “Sale ends in…” countdown
– 📅 Set sale timer individually per product
– ⚡ Lightweight and optimized for speed
– 🛍 Fully compatible with WooCommerce

Perfect for festive offers, weekend deals, flash sales, and limited-time promotions.

Credits

Made by Satish Prajapati.

License

This plugin is free and open-source under the GPLv2 or later license.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory or install it from the WordPress plugin dashboard.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
  3. Edit a WooCommerce product and scroll to the Sales Timer section.
  4. Set the sale start and end date/time for that product.
  5. Save the product. The countdown will appear on the product page automatically.
sections.faq:
Does it work with any theme?

Yes, the plugin is compatible with most WordPress themes that support WooCommerce.

Can I style the timer?

Yes, For now You can apply your own custom CSS to style the timer as per your design.

Can I use a shortcode to place the timer anywhere?

Yes, a shortcode is available to display the timer in different places as needed.

Will this slow down my website?

No, the plugin is lightweight and built for performance.
